span.p:
NORMALIZATION & FILTERING
• Name normalization — Inc / Ltd / Pvt / SARL
• Address normalization — Rd→Road, landmarks
• Missing values — 3.3% of addresses empty
• City / Country / Postcode normalization
• Unicode by CATEGORY, not word-class

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 95) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CANDIDATE GENERATION / BLOCKING
• Name similarity · Address similarity
• City / Postcode keys · TF-IDF / BM25
• Char n-gram + ANN
• Partition by COUNTRY first

div.style: color: rgb(6, 95, 70) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Why a union of blockers?
14.8% of true pairs share NO name token.
96.3% of those have address Jaccard > 0.2.
